column1: # Golden words: what a release has to show for words that a past release got wrong.
# `python -m baike2yomitan audit` checks every line and fails when one does not hold.
#   scope: full, lexical, or empty for both dictionaries
#     present / absent        the headword is (not) in the dictionary
#     reading VALUE           one of its senses has this reading
#     first_reading VALUE     the sense shown first has this reading
#     first VALUE             the sense shown first mentions VALUE (summary or sense label)
#     first_not_work          the sense shown first is not a song, film, book …
#     any VALUE               some sense mentions VALUE
#     ends VALUE              the first sense's summary ends with VALUE
#     traditional VALUE       the headword is also indexed under this spelling
#     senses_max N            it has at most N senses
#     table_lacks VALUE       no sense's info table mentions VALUE
# -- A work named after the word must not be shown first (2026.11.10.4: 时间 opened with a film song)
# -- The 2019 article must not be replaced by another article of the same title
# -- Words with two readings take the everyday one (2026.11.10.4: 明朝 míng zhāo, 教授 jiāo shòu)
# -- An article about a character lists all its readings; the common one is shown
# -- Traditional spellings use Taiwan character forms
# -- Headwords that were dropped by mistake
# -- Summaries that were cut or empty
# -- The info table must belong to the article of the summary (2026.11.10.6: 余华 the writer with a rower's table)
# -- Letter-spaced snapshots of 2023-24 are read when they have an introduction (2026.11.10.7 lacked these headwords)
五岳归来不看山，黄山归来不看岳

# -- HTML entities of the 2019 text are decoded (the build before had Soldatenkönig, zǒushénr, gèchù)
# -- A heading inside a section starts a part of its own (插足 had 含义 and 出处 inside its 详解, 海角天涯 发音, 释义, 出处 and 示例 inside its 释义)
# -- A refresh keeps the 2019 sections the snapshot has none for (旁门左道 kept only its antonym)
# -- On a character page the text ends where the input codes begin (娱 opened 基本解释拼音：yú，笔划：10 部首：女)
# -- Entities without a semicolon, escaped seven times or damaged (芾 had 五笔86&agmp;98, 机械品质因数 用Q&subm;表示)
# -- The caption of a picture of the character is taken out, not the section with it (长 and 浩 had lost their 释义)
# -- A heading with nothing to mark it (曲高和寡 had 阳春白雪反义词下里巴人成语出处战国… as its synonyms,
#    赔了夫人又折兵 opened its 用法 with 赔了夫人又折兵成文用法, 剖心坼肝 had 【出 处】 and 【用 法】 inside its 释义)
